title.zh: 【Unichain 将迁移至 OP Enterprise，主网 10 月 29 日迁移】
title.en: 【Unichain 将迁移至 OP Enterprise，主网 10 月 29 日迁移】

current_state.zh: Unichain will migrate to OP Enterprise to enable native OP Stack interoperability, with testnet migration on October 13 and mainnet migration on October 29, while chain ID, contracts, balances and deployed apps including Uniswap v2/v3/v4 remain unchanged.
current_state.en: Unichain will migrate to OP Enterprise to enable native OP Stack interoperability, with testnet migration on October 13 and mainnet migration on October 29, while chain ID, contracts, balances and deployed apps including Uniswap v2/v3/v4 remain unchanged.
